title: Headcage
summary: Headcage is a spell that the casting Seeker can utilize to protect themselves or another person from a spell or ability that targets their mind, whether it is an attack or another type of mental penetration. The spell takes the form of a green aura which surrounds the head of the target. This aura vanishes after the spell has taken effect.

sections.heading: History
sections.text:
Zhalia Moon used this spell to protect herself from Joan of Arc's curse when she touched the Ring of Arc. [Divide and Conquer]

Zhalia used the spell on Dante Vale to prevent the Professor from using Araknos to control his mind. Sophie Casterwill later asked Zhalia Moon to teach her the Headcage spell. Zhalia responded that she would teach it to Sophie. [The Secret of Two Generations]

Zhalia used the spell on the whole team at the Professor's castle to protect them from the Professor's mind control. [The Divine Comedy]
